Ravi: Heads-up: Cloudia marketplace launch coordination. Need final checklist for press embargo, joint blog, landing page, partner assets, and integration test. Can we confirm owners?
Ana: I'll take the landing page and analytics events. Need partner logo pack and two short blurbs (tech + business) from Cloudia.
CloudiaRep: Uploading now: https://drive.redwood.ai/cloudia-assets. Blurbs incoming, sending a 1-line quote from our VP.
Michael: I'll handle blog and press one-pager. Proposed embargo 2025-01-15 09:00 PT. Legal needs partner-signed co-announcement by 2025-01-12.
LegalBot: Noted. Submitted minor edits to the co-announcement docs. Please route partner ack asap.
DesignBot: Will deliver hero + 3 badge sizes and marketplace thumbnail. Prefer inline lockup with partner logo. ETA 01/08.
Ana: Tracking UTMs: utm_source=cloudia&utm_medium=partner_listing&utm_campaign=cloudia_launch_jan25. Also request events: partner_cta_click, marketplace_provision_attempt.
Michael: Drafts I'll post 01/05 for review. Need partner quote final by 01/06 to include in blog.
Ravi: Action list: Ana=landing + analytics; Michael=press+blog; DesignBot=assets; LegalBot=signoff; CloudiaRep=assets+quote. Can everyone confirm target ship timeline to meet 01/15 embargo?
DesignBot: Confirmed.
Ana: Confirmed, will QA tracking on staging by 01/10.
CloudiaRep: Confirmed, sending final quote today.
Ravi: I'll schedule a 30m dry-run on 01/14 10:00 PT. Ping here if anything slips. Thanks! :rocket:
